tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// srad rgyud lugs kyi ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ mi mthun kun zhi phan bde'i 'dod 'jo mkhan// lha mo ri khrod ma la gus btud nas// de yi sgrub thabs yid ches man ngag bcas// bla ma'i gsung bzhin 'dir ni bri bar bya// de la dkyil 'khor chen por dbang bskur ba dang 'di'i rjes gnang man ngag thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas sgom bzlas bya ba la/ thog mar skyabs sems spyi dang 'dra bar byas/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che sna tshogs kyi ri bo dang*/ ljon shing sna tshogs kyi nags tshal dang*/ me tog sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang nyid kyi rnam par shes pa pam̐ yig gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma rtsa zhal gser gyi mdog can/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa la sbrul dkar po dkris pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ gnyis pas dgra s+t+wa 'debs pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ gnyis pas shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang g.yab g.yob pa/ gsum pas gzhu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi rting pas 'og phyogs brten cing pus mo gdan du btsugs pa/ g.yon bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ shing lo gsar pa'i smad g.yogs can/ sbrul dkar po'i phreng bas se ral kha byas pa/ de'i thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun ma nag mo/

mgrin par sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun ma dmar mo sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs gsum gyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur sogs sh+lo ka gsum mam dang po gang rung*/ oṃ par+ṇa shā ba ri sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ 'di gsum mam nyer gcig skabs sbyar byed gsungs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las rigs gsum ga la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod rdzas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog ces pa nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod lha spros te/ oṃ par+ṇa shā ba rī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul las shā ba rī// lha mo gang gis bsgrubs pas nad gdon bgegs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/

rigs so so'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang rang gi sa bon gyi mthar rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las rang 'dra'i sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te/ nad bdag gi lha mo nad dang bcas pa rnams sku'i 'od zer gyis bsregs zhal du gsol/ phyag mtshan gyis thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag yang sku las 'od zer 'phros/ lhag ma'ang bsregs/ thal ba rnams rlung gis bskyod/ slar yang sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs nas dri ma bag chags tsam yang med par dag par bsams la/ oṃ pi sha tsi par+ṇa shā ba rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ oṃ thiṃ tha ra te su dun+te dz+wa la saṃ bha raṃ swā hā/ oṃ kun dhe kun bha n laṃ bh+rūm̐ shal shal/ dug sod/ rgyu gzer sod swā hā/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ 'dir ma gtogs kyang rims la sngags 'di bzla srol yod pas/ oṃ daṃ bh+yoḥ yag bh+yoḥ 'bras gzer bh+yoḥ 'brum gzer bh+yoḥ snying gzer bh+yoḥ lhog gzer bh+yoḥ rgyu gzer bh+yoḥ mā ra ya kha daṃḥ yang*/ oṃ tshi rtul rtulaḥ rmugs shig shigaḥ hri raṃ tsag tri yaḥ rbad ma la ya rbadaḥ sarba ma la ya rbadaḥ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes kyang bzla/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor zlum po'am snying gzugs gsum gcig gang rung bsham/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsum/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sarba ar+tha sā dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas gtor mgron gyi lha mo spyan drang*/

ljags rdo rje 'od zer gyi sbu gus gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa shā ba rī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis dbul/ mchod pa dang bstod pa sngar bzhin bya/ gtor mgron rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol bya/ bsngo ba dang smon lam shis brjod sogs spyi ltar bya'o// 'di la brten pa'i las tshogs kyi rim pa la// ༈ /bu

1 ma chog la brten pa'i rims bsrung zhing mtshams gcod pa ni/ rang gi mdun du stegs kyi steng sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bum pa mtshan ldan mgul chings/ kha rgyan/ dung chos/ gzungs rdor/ nang bum rdzas nyer lnga'i steng*/ dzā ti/ gla rtsi/ shu dag gsum bsnan pa btab pa'i chus gang ba bzhag de'i mdun du mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma bcas bsham/ de nas rang nyid bdag bskyed bzlas pa yan grub rjes/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngar bzhin bya/ de nas bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pam̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa ring ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris shing*/ dpag bsam shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba/ de'i nang du rin po che sna tshogs kyi ri bo dang*/ ljon shing sna tshogs kyi nags tshal dang*/ zhes pa nas/ mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar sngar ltar las rang nyid ces pa'i tshig phrad 'dor dgos pa'i rigs dor/ gtor mgron zur du spyan 'dren mi dgos/ bum pa'i lha la dbul ba dang mchod bstod sngar bzhin bya/ bum pa'i lha dam ye dbyer med du bzhu ba'am/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'od du zhu bas bum pa'i chu dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces brjod de chu lha mo rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du mos/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i bum chu gnas khang gi phyi nas rim bzhin 'thor/ dmigs pa ni/ ri khrod ma gsum gyi sku dpag med spros/ de dag gis nad kyi lha mo nad dang bcas pa thams cad phyag mtshan gyis bcad cing gtubs/ zhal du gsol/ mes bsregs/ bdud rtsis bkrus/ phyogs mtshams nas dbus su'ang bsdus te/ bum chu mang tsam blugs/ ri khrod ma bskyed/ sku dpag med spros/ gtub/ bsreg bkru ba sogs bya/ nad pa yod na sbyin no// ༈ /gag lhog gzer gsum la sogs rims kyi rigs mtha' dag bsrung ba'i gtso bo brgyad thod

2 la brtan pa ni/ rdzas gtso bo rgyu gzer gyis shi ba'i khye'u lo brgyad pa'i thod pa ste/ de yang gla ba'i ril ma tsam gyi thod tshal la dz+wa ti'i chu byugs/ grib skam bya/ de bzhin du gla rtsi'i chu dang*/ de steng yang shu dag gi chu byugs/ rdzas so so byugs pa'i steng sngags mang du btab/ yang thod tshal gla ril tsam dang*/ dzā ti/ gla rtsi/ shu dag rnams zhib par brdungs te mar dang bsres/ sngags btab/ gong gi thod tshal bcu 'gyur tsam gyi dkar gong srin med ngo 'jam po gcig la'ang sngags btab/ mar gyis dkar gong dang thod pa sbyar/ de'i phyi mar gyis btums pa'i star kha che ba tsam de la'ang sngags btab/ de nas ras dkar po dri med kyis btum/ dar skud dam ras skud kyis kha bcings/ de la'ang sngags mang du btab/ de nyid chu mig gam chu ra lta bu la bcug pas chu 'thung ba kun la 'go mi srid do// thum bu de'ang chu nang du zhag gsum tsam las mang bar bzhag na rul yong bas mi dgos pa'i dus ras kyi chu bskams te par bu lta bur bcug ste nam dgos dus longs spyad par bya'o// ༈ /gag lhog gzer gsum cham pa sogs nad rigs gang la'ang phan pa'i sman ba 3 cos la/ sman khyung lnga yongs grags ltar gyi steng*/ glang chen gi'u waṃ/ shing kun/ stag sha nag po/ sdig srin/ thar nu/ ma nu/ byi thang ka bcu gang*/ bu ram/ gu gul/ chu rtsa/ ga pur/ sug smel/ li shi/ sha chen/ bla ma'am sngags pa nus pa can nam dge slong gtsang ma gang rung gi dri chen/ dri chu/ de rnams zhib btags ril bu sran ma chung shos tsam dril/ grib skam/ rin po che'i snod du ril chags byas/ ril bu rnams bum par blug bdag mdun bsgrub/ sngags mang du bgrang*/ zhu ba las byung ba'i ril bur bsam/ nad stobs dang bstun pa'i ril bu gcig gnyis tsam btang bas phan no// ༈ /nad rims bsru 4 nga zhing mtshams gcod pa ni/ lung pa dang gnas gzhi gang yin de'i dbus su ri khrod ma bskyed/

sku las rang 'dra dpag tu med pa spros pas/ gtubs gsol bsregs bkrus la sogs byas/ slar yang sku las 'od zer 'phros pas pad+ma dmar po'i rwa gur/ de'i phyir khro bo'i rdo rje ser nag gang rung*/ de'i phyir khro chu/ de'i phyir me kha dog lnga/ de'i phyir rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i gur bsam/ bsdu na/ pad+ma/ rdo rje/ me'i rwa ba bsam mo// ༈ /rims kyis gtses pa'i nad kha pa'i sar 'gro na/ rang la thog mar gang sbyin gyi bza' btung la mtheb srin gtad/ srin lag ri khrod mar bskyed/ de las sprul pas gtubs bsregs bkrus/ sngags bzlas/ yang nas brngos pa'i bye ma/ yungs kar/ yungs nag ske tshe/ lcags sol/ rdo nag po bsres pa'am/ ma 'dzoms na bye ma dul ma lha mor bskyed/ sngags mang du bzla/ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha mo rdul phra rab tu bsam/ mtha' nas gtor ba sogs dmigs sngags sngar bzhin no/ ༈ /rims kyis shi ba'i rus bu ga lta bu nas nad mched dogs na/ mtha' nas phar rus bu dngos la'ang 'thor/ ༈ /shi kha gcod pa'i tha nga bas ni/ shing leb mtho gang gru bzhi pa'i dbus su g.yung drung g.yas skor spyi ltar brkos/ g.yung drung gi lte ba dang*/ mtshams bzhir khung bu re brus/ brgyad thod gla ril tsam la dz+wa ti gla rtsi shu dag gi chu byugs/ grim skam bya/ sngags btab/ sman gsum brgyad thod dang bcas zhib par btags/ mar la sbyar/ sngags btab/ g.yung drung gi lte bar mar cung zad sbyar/ de steng brgyad thod glan/ de steng mar 'bur tsam/ g.yung drung gi logs dang*/ mtshams kyi khung bu kun la mar glan/ mar rnams kyi steng bya ma dul mas bkab/ de nyid phyi sgo'i ya them steng bzhag pas phan no/ ༈ /phyugs nad gcod ca na g.yung drung g.yon skor yin no// gzhan byings 'dra bas sngar ltar bsgrubs pa phyugs rnams yong ba'i sgo steng nas g.yung drung gi khar chu blug chu de phyugs lug rnams kyi mgo thog tu phog par byas pas phan no// zhes pa 'di ni rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po dkon mchog yar 'phel gyis phyag len tu 'gel bar gnang bzhin pa/

dge slong 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyis zin bris su bkod pa'o// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi las phran myong bas grub pa bzhugs so// swa sti/ ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi bsnyen pa las su rung bas/ las tshogs kyis gzhan la phan gdags par 'dod na/ khye'u lo brgya 1 da pa nad ngan pas shi ba'i thod pa'i dum bu gla ril tsam la/ dzā ti/ gla rtsi/ shu dag gsum gyis snga ma snga ma skam rim gyis phyi ma phyi ma byugs/ de nas ri khrod ma rigs gsum du bskyed/ ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi rtsa sngags gang mang du btab/ de dang dkar gong srin med gtsang ma gla ril bcu 'gyur tsam gnyis mar gyis sbyar/ gong gi thod pa dang sman gsum gyi phye ma mar la sbyar ba thod pa'i dum bu dang dkar gong sbyar ba mi dang nor phyugs rnams ri khrod ma rigs gsum du bskyed/ sngags mang du btab/ rdzas de ras dkar dri med kyis btums la chu ra dang chu mig sogs su 'jug/ ༈ /nad pa yod sa 2 ra 'gro ba'i tshe/ nas brngos pa'i bye ma dul ma ri khrod ma rigs gsum du bskyed/ sngags gang mang btab pa rang ri khrod mar bsgoms pas khyer te grong ngam yul de mthong ba na sngags bzla zhing bye ma gtor/ yul de'i nad bdag ma mo sogs rim gyis bye ma ri khrod mar gsal ba rnams kyis bskor te nang du bsdus par bsam/ yul de la bskor thub na bskor bzhin pas bye ma gtor zhing de ltar bsam/ mi thub na'ang dmigs pa de bzhin bya/ mthar nad bdag thams cad phyogs gcig tu spungs pa'i mtha' skor du ri khrod mas bskor bar bsams zhing steng du ri khrod ma gsum bskyed/ sngags bzlas shing ri khrod ma'i mtha' 'khor na gnas pa rnams kyis mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis bcad gtubs zhal du gsol/ steng du gnas pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas bsregs/ mthar nad bdag gi sems sdig sems dang bral ba de sos par gyur pa la bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis dbang bskur sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs par yang yang bsam/

༈ /nad pa yod pa'i bza' btung la spyod da 3 gos byung tshe/ bza' btung gang yin pa de'i steng*/ rang ri khrod mar gsal ba'i srin lag g.yon ri khrod mar bsgoms pa'i zhabs kyis mnan/ de'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis me spros te zas kyi nad gdon mi gtsang ba thams cad bsregs par yang yang bsams la spyad/ ༈ /nad ga 4 so na/ rang ri khrod mar bsgom/ nad pa'i nad dang nad bdag thams cad nad pa'i steng du spungs/ de'i steng du ri khrod ma bskyed/ sngags bzla zhing*/ ri khrod ma'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i ri khrod ma dpag tu med pas nad bdag thams cad bsdus te bskor/ spros pa'i mes nad pa nad bdag nad thams cad bsregs/ spyi bo'i bdud rtsi'i chus nad pa nad dang bral ba dang*/ nad bdag gnod sems dang bral ba gsos shing dbang bskur bas sdig sgrib sbyangs/ nad bdag sdig sgrib dang bral nas rang gnas su gshegs/ nad pa nad gdon sdig sgrib dang bral ba'i mtha' bskor du/ sku gsung thugs kyi rwa ba dgu/ de'i mthar pad 'dab/ rdo rje/ khro chu/ rlung me rnams kyis bskor bar bsam/ ༈ /shi kha bye ba bsrung 5 na/ shing mtho gang gru bzhi'i dbus g.yung drung ris 'di bzhin brkos/ de'i yang lte ba kyong bur brkos la/ sngar bshad pa'i thod pa/ dzā ti/ gla rtsi/ shu dag rnams kyi phye ma mar dang sbyar bas g.yung drung ris kyi nang du sum cha gcig nang dang cha gcig phyir 'bur ba tsam byug cing lte bar sngar bshad pa'i rdzas byug cing sngags btab pa'i thod pa dum bu gla ril tsam pa bcug la/ g.yung drung lte ba dang bcas pa la bye ma dul ma btab ste/ ri khrod mar bskyed la gzhan gyis mi mthong bar sgo steng du g.yung drung yar bstan nas bzhag ༈ /phyugs 6 nad gso na g.yung drung ris 'di bzhin/ gzhan ma gong dang 'dra ba sgo steng du bzhag pa'i steng nas gzhan du bshad pa bzhin bsgrubs pa'i bum chu blugs pa 'bab pa'i chu phyugs rnams 'thung du gzhug cing*/

lus la 'debs/ ༈ /yul bsru 7 nga ni/ ri mo/ ཿཾཿཾ 'di bzhin gyi dbus su yul gyi ming bye ma dul mas bris te/ de yul dngos su mos/ de'i steng du mañji'i khar bum pa bzhag rang ri khrod mar gsal/ bum pa'i nang du ri khrod ma bskyed/ de'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyi mes yul de'i mi mthun phyogs bsregs/ bdud rtsi'i chus bkrus par yang yang bsams zhing sngags gang mang bzlas/ mthar gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs bya/ ༈ /dmar mo'i sngags/ oṃ thiṃ tha ra tis dun+te dz+wa la saṃ bha raṃ swā hā/ nag mo'i sngags/ oṃ kun+te kun+dhan laṃ druṃ shal shal dug sod rgyu gzer sod swā hā/ ༈ /rims srung sngags/ oṃ tshi brtul brtul/ rmugs shig shig hri raṃ tsa kri rbad/ sarba mā ra ya rbad hūm̐ rbad swā hā/ rims srung ril bu la/ rgyal po khyung lnga ni/ btsan dug gang bzang*/ snying gi khyung*/ gla rtsi khrag gi khyung*/ ru rta rus pa'i khyung*/ shu dag nag po/ rgyus pa'i khyung*/ a ru ra */gser mdog sha yi khyung ngo*// blon po lnga ni/ sha chen/ dri chen/ gi'u waṃ/ li shi/ sug smel lo// 'bangs lnga ni/ thar nu/ stag sha/ sdig srin/ gu gul/ shing kun no// g.yog lnga ni/ ma nu/ byi tang ka chu rtswa/ cu gang*/ bu ram mo// 'di rnams zhib par btags la/ bla ma bzang po'i byung na rab/ dge slong gtsang ma'am khye'u lo brgyad pa'i dri chus sbrus/ ril bu sran ma chung shos tsam bsgril/ li khri'am mtshal gyis na bza' gsol/ ri khrod mar bskyed/ sngags gang mang btab/ ri khrod ma zhu ba las byung ba'i ril bur gyur pa'am/ yang na steng du bskyed de zhu ba thim par bsam/ gang la btab kyang phan no// ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi las phran myong bas grub pa*// ༈ /ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti/ ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi rjes gnang bya tshul ni/ slob dpon gyis bdag bskyed sngon du btang*/

gtor ma lhar bskyed/ slob ma khrus byas/ gral la 'khod/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod cing bum chus khrus bya/ bden bdar dang khro bo'i sngags brjod cing khro bo spros te bgegs bskrad/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ dkon mchog gsum mas byang sdom bzung*/ slob ma bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ri khrod ma rigs gsum du bskyed/ ye shes pa bstims te lha ngo bstan/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gtor ma lhar bskyed pa la phog de'i ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi gnas lnga las ri khrod ma dkar dmar mthing ser ljang ba lnga tshan gsum spros/ slob ma'i rigs gsum gyi gnas lnga so so la thim/ lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag khyad par lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sngar yod dag ste phyin chad mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ ri khrod ma'i sku dkar mo'i rwa ba/ 'khor lo'i rwa ba/ 'od dkar po'i rwa ba gsum gyis bskor/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// yang gsol ba btab/ slob ma rigs gsum gyi thugs kar nyi ma la rang rang gi sa bon/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gtor ma'i rigs gsum gyi thugs kar phog thugs ka'i sngags phreng las gnyis pa chad de slob ma'i rigs gsum gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar 'khod par bsams la sngags lan gsum gsum bzlas/ ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag rdo rje'i gsung 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag khyad par ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib slar mi 'jug pa'i phyir sku'i rwa ba gsum gyi nang du ri khrod ma dmar mo'i rwa ba/ pad+ma'i rwa ba/ 'od dmar po'i rwa ba gsum gyis bskor ba gsung gi rjes gnang*/ yang gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gtor ma'i rigs gsum gyi thugs kar phog rigs gsum so so'i phyag mtshan rdo rje ser po dang*/

nag po rtse lnga pa/ pad+ma dmar po gsum dpag tu med pa slob ma'i thugs kar thim/ yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag rdo rje'i thugs 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag khyad par yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib slar mi 'jug pa'i phyir rwa ba snga ma rnams kyi nang du ri khrod ma nag mo/ rdo rje/ 'od sngon po'i rwa ba gsum gyis bskor/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// de nas gtor ma'i lha bstim/ de nas/ bkra shis tshe brtan gyis dngos grub ril bu sbyin/ shis brjod sogs bya'o// ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi rjes gnang bla ma'i phyag len ltar 'khrul med du bkod pa dge'o// ༈ /srad rgyud lugs kyi ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa nad rims kun sel bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs dbyer med pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// rgud pa'i nyer 'tshe 'khrud pa'i cho ga mkhan// ri khrod lha mo'i sgrub thabs las sbyor rnams// 'khrul bral bla ma'i nyams bzhes phyag len bzhin// bstan 'gro'i 'tsho byed bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'di spel// de la 'dir spyir sngags kyi 'jug sgo dam pa rgyud sde bzhir bshad pa'i dbang legs par thob pa dang*/ khyad par du ri khrod ma gtso 'khor gsum gyi rjes gnang dang man ngag legs par thob pa'i rnal 'byor pas nyams su len pa la/ thog mar bsnyen pa bya tshul dang*/ bsnyen pa song nas las tshogs rnams bya tshul gnyis/ dang po ni skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che sna tshogs kyi ri bo dang*/ ljon shing sna tshogs kyi nags tshal dang*/ me tog sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang nyid kyi rnam par shes pa bam̐ yig gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal gser gyi mdog can/ g.yas zhal dkar po zhi ba/ g.yon zhal dmar po chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa la sbrul dkar pos dkris pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ gnyis pas dgra s+t+wa 'debs pa'i tshul du mdzad pa/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ gnyis pas shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang g.yab g.yob pa/ gsum pas gzhu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi rting pas 'og phyogs brten cing pus mo gdan du btsugs pa/ g.yon bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ shing lo gsar ba'i smad g.yogs can/ sbrul dkar po'i phreng ba'i se ral kha byas pa/ de'i

ser mo sku'i/ dmar mo gsung gi/ sngon mo thugs kyi lha mo ste/ gsum ka 'god tshul la ser po dbus/ dmar po dang sngon po g.yas g.yon du 'god pa'am 'di ltar 'god la/ zhal phyag rgyan phyag mtshan sogs gtso bo lta bu'am/ yang na gzhan gnyis zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas g.yon gyi gtso bo'i rtsa ba'i phyag mtshan bsnams pa bzhugs tshul rgyan sogs lhag ma mthun par bya/ rgyud chen sangs rgyas kyi sgrub thabs sogs la yod gsung ngo*// thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun nag mo/ mgrin par sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du rje btsun ma dmar mo sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rigs gsum gyi spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs sh+lo ka gsum mam dang po gang rung gi rjes su/ oṃ par+ṇa shā ba rī sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyi zin bris la dzaḥ'adi gsum mam/ nyer gcig skabs sbyar byed gsung gi snang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las rigs gsum ga la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang nyid la thim par gyur/ mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ nas/ oṃ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas mchod lha spros te/ oṃ par+ṇa shā ba rī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul las shā ba rī// lha mo gang gis bsgrubs pas nad gdon bgegs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ rigs lha mo gsum gyi thugs gar pam̐ yig rang mdog can gyi mthar rang sngags rang mdog can 'og nas 'chad pas bskor bar dmigs la/ rang 'dra'i spro bsdu bya gsungs/ so so'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sa bon gyi mthar rang rang gi sku mdog dang mtshungs pa'i sngags phreng gis bskor ba'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/ rang 'dra'i sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros te nad bdag gi lha mo zer yang ma mo dang mkha' 'gro'i rigs yin/ nad dang bcas pa rnams sku'i 'od zer gyis bsregs/ zhal du gsol/ phyag mtshan gyis thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag yang sku las 'od zer 'phros/ lhag ma bsregs pa'i thal ba rnams rlung gis gtor/ mkhan chen zin bris la bskyed zer/ slar yang sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas dri ma bag chags tsam yang med par dag par bsams la/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa shā ba rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ oṃ thiṃ tha ra te sa dun+te dz+wa la saṃ bha raṃ swā hā/ mkhan chen gyis bhaṃ zer/ oṃ kun dhe kunaṃ bhan laṃ kru mkhan chen bh+rūm̐ zer/ shal shal dug sod/ rgyu gzer sod swā hā/ zhes pa ci mang bzla zhes mkhan chen zer snang*/

sngags 'di gsum gyi dang po ri khrod ma ser mo'i dang*/ gnyis pa dmar mo'i dang*/ gsum pa sngon mo'i yin cing*/ phyi ma gnyis spyi 'joms kyi sngags dang*/ khyad par gsum pa rgyu gzer sogs rims la bsngags zhes bla ma gsung ngo*// 'dir mi gtogs kyang rims la bsngags pa 'di bzla srol yod la/ oṃ daṃ bh+yoḥ yag bh+yoḥ 'bras gzer bh+yoḥ 'brum gzer bh+yoḥ snying gzer bh+yoḥ lhog gzer bh+yoḥ rgyu gzer bh+yoḥ mā ra ya kha thaṃḥ mkhan chen gyis kha dhaṃ zer snang*/ yang*/ oṃ tshe rtul rtulaḥ rmugs shig shigaḥ hri raṃ tsag tri sadaḥ rbad ma la ya rbadaḥ sarba ma la ya rbadaḥ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hāḥ zhes kyang bzlas/ sngags 'di gnyis 'di'i sgos sngags min kyang gzhan nas 'byung ba kha tshar la dam pa rnams kyis btags pa yin 'dra/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor zlum po'am/ snying gzugs gsum mam gcig gang rung bsham/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum brjod la byin gyis brlab/ yang mkhan chen gyis de las a kā ro gsum brjod rjes/ oṃ ru ru s+phu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sarba ar+tha sā dha ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan gsum gyi byin rlabs zhig snang zhing*/ bdag la 'di ma gsungs pa dang mi dgos pa yang 'dra snyam zhing sngags chad pa dang ma dag pa 'dra snyam pas dpyad do// rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas gtor mgron gyi lha mo spyan drangs/ ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa shā ba rī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis dbul/ mchod pa dang bstod pa sngar bzhin bya/

gtor mgron rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na gshegs gsol bya/ bsngo ba smon lam shis brjod bya'o// gnyis pa bsnyen pa song nas las tshogs byed tshul la/ bum chog la brten nas rims bsrung zhing mtshams gcod pa dang*/ brgyad thod la brten nas gag lhog gzer gsum sogs rims kyi rigs mtha' dag bsrung ba dang*/ spyi 'joms ril bu la brten nas gag lhog gzer gsum cham pa sogs nad rigs gang la'ang phan pa'i sman bcos dang*/ bsrung zhing mtshams gcod pa sogs las sna gces bsdus thor bu'i skor rang bzhi/ dang po ni/ rang gi mdun du stegs kyi steng sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan la bum pa mtshan ldan mgul chings/ kha rgyan/ dung chos/ gzungs rdor dang*/ nang du bum rdzas nyer lnga'i steng du/ dzā ti/ gla rtsi/ shu dag gsum bsnan pa btab pa'i chus gang ba bzhag de'i mdun du mchod pa gtor ma dang bcas pa bsham/ de nas rang nyid bdag bskyed bzlas pa yan grub rjes/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngar bzhin byas/ de nas bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du pam̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ lto ba ldir ba/ zhabs zhum pa/ mgrin pa ring ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba de'i nang du rin po che sna tshogs kyi ri bo dang*/ ljon shing sna tshogs kyi nags tshal dang*/ zhes pa nas mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar sngar ltar las rang nyid ces pa'i tshig phrad sogs ci rigs dor/ bum pa'i lha la gtor ma dbul ba dang*/ yang mchod bstod sngar bzhin byas/ bum lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba bum pa'i chu dang gnyis su med par gyur/ ces brjod de chu lha mo'i rdul phra rab kyi rang bzhin du mos/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i bum chu gnas khang gi phyi nas rim bzhin 'thor/

dmigs pa ni/ ri khrod ma gsum gyi sku dpag tu med pa spros/ de dag gis nad kyi lha mo nad dang bcas pa thams cad phyag mtshan gyis bcad cing gtubs/ zhal du gsol/ mes bsregs/ bdud rtsis bkrus/ phyogs mtshams nas dbus su'ang bsdus te bum chu mang tsam blugs/ ri khrod mar bskyed/ sku dpag med spros/ gtubs/ bsregs/ bkrus pa sogs bya/ nad pa yod na sbyin no// gnyis pa ni/ rdzas kyi gtso bo brgyad thod ni/ 'brum mkhan chen gyi rgyu gzer gyis shi ba las mi 'dug kyang bdag la rims sogs kyis shi ba dang de'i nang nas gtso bo gzer 'brum gnyis ka gsung*/ pa'am rgyu gzer gyis shi ba'i khye'u lo brgyad pa'i thod pa ste/ de yang gla ba'i ril ma tsam gyi thod tshal la/ dzā ti dang*/ ba'i chu byugs la grib skam byas/ de bzhin du de'i steng du gla rtsi'i chu dang*/ de'i steng du shu dag gi chu byug rdzas so sos byugs pa'i steng du sngags mang du btab/ de nas thod tshal gla ril tsam dang*/ dzā ti/ gla rtsi/ shu dag rnams zhib par bsdus te mar dang bsres la sngags btab/ gong gi thod tshal bcu 'gyur tsam gyi dkar gong srin rdo dkar po'i steng du nag po sogs med pa'i ming yin gsung*/ med ngos 'jam po gcig la'ang sngags btab/ mar gyis dkar gong dang thod pa sbyar/ de'i phyi mar gyis btums pa star kha che ba tsam de la'ang sngags btab/ de nas ras dkar po dri med kyis btum/ dar skud dam ras skud kyis kha bcings/ de la'ang sngags mang du btab pa de chu mig gam chu ra lta bu la bcug pas chu 'thung ba kun la nad rims de dag 'go mi srid do// thum bu de'ang chu nang du zhag gsum tsam las mang bar bzhag na rul yong bas/ rgyun par 'jog mi dgos par chu 'chu ba sogs kyi skabs su bzhag la/ mi dgos pa'i dus ras kyi chu bskams te par bu lta bur bcug la nam dgos dus spyad par bya'o// gsum pa ni/

sman khyung lnga yongs grags ltar gyi steng du/ glang chen gyi gi'u waṃ/ shing kun/ stag sha nag po/ sdig srin/ thar nu/ ma nu/ byi tang ka cu gang*/ bu ram/ gu gul/ chu rtsa/ ga bur/ sug smel/ li shi/ sha chen/ bla ma'am/ sngags pa nus pa can nam/ dge slong gtsang ma gang rung gi dri chen dri chu/ de rnams zhib par btags/ ril bu sran ma chung shos tsam dril grib skam byas pa rin po che'i snod du ril chags byas/ ril bu rnams bum par blug bdag mdun bsgrub/ sngags mang du bgrang*/ zhu ba las byung ba'i ril bur gyur par bsam/ nad stobs dang bstun pa'i ril bu gcig gnyis gsum tsam btang bas phan nges so// bzhi pa bsrung zhing mtshams gcod pa ni/ lung pa'am gnas gzhi gang yin de'i dbus su ri khrod ma bskyed/ sku las rang 'dra dpag med spros pas gtubs gsol bsregs bkrus sogs byas/ slar yang sku las 'od 'phros pas pad+ma dmar po'i rwa gur/ de'i phyir khro bo'i rdo rje ser nag gang rung gi rwa gur/ de'i phyir khro chu'i rwa gur/ de'i phyir me kha dog sna lnga'i rwa gur/ de'i phyir rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i rwa gur bsam/ bsdu na pad+ma rdo rje me ris kyang chog go /mtshams gcod bsrungs ba'o// rims kyis gtses pa'i sar 'gro na/ rang la thog mar gang sbyin gyi bza' btung la mtheb srin gtad/ srin lag ri khrod mar bskyed/ de nas sprul pas gtubs bsregs bkrus/ sngags bzlas/ yang nas brngos pa'i bye ma/ yungs kar/ yungs nag ske tshe/ lcags sol/ 'di khol tsha yin/ rdo nag bsregs pa'am/ ma 'dzom na bye ma dul ma lha mor bskyed/ sngags mang du bzlas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i rdul phra rab kyi lha mor bsam/ mtha' nas gtor/ dmigs pa sngar bzhin no// nad byung ba'i grong mtha' bskor nas bye ma sogs sngags dmigs byas pas nad mched mi thub par yang bdag la bla ma dam pas gsung ngo*// rang srung zab mo'o// rims kyis shi ba'i rus bu lta bu nas nad rims mched dogs na/

mtha' nas rus bu dngos la'ang 'thor/ shi kha gcod pa'i thabs ni/ shing leb mtho gang gru bzhi pa'i dbus su g.yung drung g.yas skor spyi ltar brkos/ g.yung drung lte ba dang mtshams bzhir khung bu re brus/ brgyad thod gla ril tsam la dzā ti/ gla rtsi/ shu dag gi chu byugs/ grib skam byas/ sngags btab/ sman gsum brgyad thod dang bcas pa zhib par btags/ mar la sbyar nas sngags btab/ g.yung drung gi lte bar mar cung zad sbyar/ de'i steng du brgyad thod glan/ de'i steng mar 'bur tsam/ g.yung drung gi logs dang mtshams kyi khung bu kun la mar glan/ mar rnams kyi steng bye ma dul mas bkab/ de nyid phyi sgo'i ya them steng bzhag pas phan no// phyugs nad gcod na g.yung drung g.yon gong du bri/ gzhan rnams 'dra bas sngar ltar bsgrub pa byas pa de phyugs rnams yongs pa'i sgo steng nas g.yung drung gi khar chu blugs la chu de phyugs rnams kyi mgo la gtor zhing dmigs pa sngar ltar byas pas phan nges so// 'di dag ni nyams myong thon nges yin pa'i gtan tshigs lo rgyus sogs yod do// smras pa/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs rje'i chu mtsho las// 'thon pa'i ri khrod dbang mo'i zla ba ni// nad rims gdung ba sel la ga bur rgyun// sgrub pa'i thabs su 'dzag pa 'di yin gzungs// chu 'dod smrig rgyu 'thungs la brel ba bzhin// srog 'phrog ha la'i rkyal pa thogs pa las// gcig chog lha mo'i 'phrul 'di zungs shig dang*// gzhung nas bshad bzhin 'byung ba mngon sum grub// tshul 'dir 'bad dges spyi dang tsong kha pa'i// mdo dang sngags kyi bshad sgrub zla med pa// gang dang der 'dzin sbyin bdag bcas pa kun// 'phel rgyas phyogs dus kun tu dge gyur cig /ces ri khrod lo ma can rnam gsum gyi sgrub thabs nad rims kun sel bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'di ni/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'chang dkon mchog yar 'phel gyis bla ma gong ma'i gsung rgyun phyag len la gnang ba rnams bdag la stsal ba dang*/

mkhan chen 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyi zin bris gnyis mi mthun pa rnams mchan bur byas te rig sngags 'chang ba 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rjes yi ger bkod pa 'dis kyang kun mkhyen tsong kha pa'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par dpal ldan srad rgyud kyi bshad sgrub phyogs dus kun tu dar bar gyur cig/ ༈ /spyi 'joms ril bu'i sdeb sbyor ni/ sman chen/ gla rtsi/ shu dag a ru ra gser mdog sha pho ru rta/ sha chen/ dri chen/ gi'u waṃ/ cu gang*/ byi tang ka/ li shi/ sug smel/ sdig srin/ stag sha/ bu ram/ shing kun/ gu gul/ thar nu/ chu rtsa/ ma nu 'di rnams zhib par btags la/ ril bu sran ma'i phyed tsam bsgril/ mtshal lam li khri'i na bza' gsol/ rab gnas byas/ dge slong gtsang ma'i dri chus ril bu bya/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa shā ba rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ ser mo'i sngags so// oṃ thi ma tha ra tis dun+te dz+wa la shaṃ ba raṃ swā hā/ dmar mo'i sngags so// oṃ kun dhe kun bha na lam kruṃ shal shal du ga sod rgyu gzer sod swā hā/ sngon mo'i sngags sham bu dang bcas pa'o// sngags rkyang la shal shal yan chad kyis chog zer/ ser mo dbus/ dmar mo g.yas/ sngon mo g.yon du 'dug gsung*/ phyag len ser mo'i mgrin pa dang thugs kar dmar sngo gnyis 'god par mdzad gsung*/ sngags kyi grangs ni bye ba'am/ mtshan ma mthong gi bar/ 'bring 'bum ther bcu'am 'bum ther kha yar song ba/ tha ma'ang 'bum ther gcig gam khri phrag brgyad sogs ni las tshogs sgrub pa la dgos gsung ngo*// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rgya gar gyi grub chen gcig gis 'bri mtshams kyi sngags pa gcig la gnang*/ de nas rang gi rigs rgyud kho na las gzhan su la'ang mi ster ba'i bka' rgya byas te rim par brgyud pa las/ dus phyis zhig na paṇa chen bsam 'grub rgya mtshos de'i sngags pa gcig la gdams pa nged la ster dgos byas pas/ khyed nges cag gi skyabs mgon yin pas ster dgos med kyang*/

gzhan la mi spel ba'i dam bca' bzhes dgos zhus pas/ kho bo 'gro ba la phan e thogs bsam pa yin/ gzhan la spel mi rung na mi dgos gsungs ma bzhes/ slar rgyud chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho de'i rigs brgyud du 'khrungs pas/ dus phyis rang gi a khu sngags btsun gcig la nga la ster dgos gsungs pas/ khyod la ster kyang gzhan la ma spel gsungs pa na/ de ring khyed kyis brtsams pa'i nyin 'dir skyor ba dang 'dri ba byed dgos/ gzhan mi byed ces gsungs nas rgyud chen dkon rgyal la yol ba'i phag tu gsan bcug nas gnang*/ rgyud chen des dkon mchog yar 'phel sogs shin tu mang po la sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang las tshogs gnang ste spel ba yin gyi/ rgyud chen rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas rgya mtshos kyang nyin rer tshar gcig las ma gsungs gsung*/ rje de la bdag 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa'i rdo rje las tshogs dang bcas par legs par zhus so// shu bhaṃ// ༈ /ri khrod lo ma gyon ma rigs gsum gyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bdud rtsi'i sprin mdzes zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru be/ bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// ri khrod lha mo rigs gsum la// btud nas de yi sgrub thabs dang*// rjes gnang bdud rtsi'i sprin mdzes spel// 'di la gsum ste/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so// dang po ni/ gnas dben par stegs kyi khar rten gtor dkar zlum mthar ril bus bskor ba dang*/ de'i mdun du 'bul gtor/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdor dril/ me tog gul yungs sogs dgos pa'i yo byad dang*/ nye logs ci rigs par las kyi bum pa'ang bsham mo// gnyis pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngar ltar dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgoms pas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ swa bhā was chos thams cad stong par sbyangs nas ye shes kyi tshogs bsags te/

stong pa'i ngang las rin po che sna tshogs kyi ri bo dang*/ ljon shing sna tshogs kyi nags tshal dang*/ me tog sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa'i dbus su pam̐ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang*/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge bam̐ gser gyi mdog can/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun ri khrod lo ma gyon ma sku'i lha mo sku mdog gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa zhal rgyas pa gser gyi mdog can/ g.yas zhal dung ltar dkar zhing zhi ba/ g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re la'ang dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa la brang 'gro dkar pos dkris pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing*/ gnyis pas dgra s+t+wa 'debs tshul mdzad pa/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ gnyis pas shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang g.yab g.yob pa/ gsum pas gzhu bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas rting pas 'og phyogs brten cing pus mo gdan du btsugs pa/ g.yon pa bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ shing lo gsar pa'i smad g.yogs gyon pa/ brang 'gro dkar po'i phreng bas se ral kha byas pa/ de'i thugs kar sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du thugs kyi lha mo nag mo/ mgrin par sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du gsung gi lha mo

'di'i lha mo dmar mo g.yas dang*/ sngon mo g.yon du 'god par bzhed pa'ang yod cing mdun bskyed la de ltar nges par 'thad/ dmar mo/ gnyis ka'ang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa la sbrul gyis dkris pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pas 'og phyogs brten cing pus mo gdan la btsugs pa/ g.yon bzhengs stabs su bzhugs pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ shing lo gsar pa'i smad g.yogs can/ sbrul dkar po'i se ral kha byas pa'o/ de gsum ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ par+ṇa shā ba rī sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi dzaḥdzaḥdza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa so so dang gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs gsum ka la mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan cing*/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang nyid la thim par gyur/ de nas mchod pa rnams bsang sbyang byin rlabs spyi ltar bya/ oṃ par+ṇa shā ba rī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul las shā ba rī// lha mo gang gis bsgrubs pas nad gdon bgegs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/

rigs so so'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bam̐ yig rang rang gi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i mthar sngags phreng gsum po so sos bskor ba las rang 'dra'i sprul pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te nad bdag gi lha mo nad dang bcas pa rnams sku'i 'od zer gyis bsregs shing zhal du gsol/ phyag mtshan gyis thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag yang sku las 'od zer 'phros lhag ma'ang bsregs thal ba rlung gis gtor/ slar sngags phreng sa bon dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros pa'i rtse las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ dri ma bag chags tsam yang med par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa shā ba rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ zhes sku'i lha mo dang*/ oṃ thim thar te dun+te dz+wa la saṃ bhā raṃ swā hā/ zhes gsung gi dang*/ oṃ kun+te kun+dhan laṃ bh+rūm̐ shal shal du ga sod rgyu gzer sod swā hā/ zhes thugs kyi lha mo'i sngags te ji ltar rigs pa bzla/ mthar gzhan nas 'byung ba'i las kha tshar gyi sngags/ oṃ hūm̐ bh+yoḥ yag bh+yoḥ 'bras gzer bh+yoḥ 'brum gzer bh+yoḥ snying gzer bh+yoḥ lhog gzer bh+yoḥ rgyu gzer bh+yoḥ mā ra ya kha thaṃḥ yang*/ oṃ tshi brtul brtulaḥ rmugs shig shigaḥ hri raṃ tsag tri sadaḥ rbad ma la ya rbadaḥ sarba ma la ya rbadaḥ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad re bzlas/ las thams cad kyi bum par khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa gsal ba'i ba spu'i bu ga nas rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rdul phra rab dpag tu med pa babs pas bum pa khengs par bsams la/ a mṛ ta ci nus bzlas la/ lha 'od du zhu ba las bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam/ mdun gyi gtor ma bsang sbyang*/ bdag bskyed ltar yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis bskyed/ mchod pa bsang sbyang byin rlabs sngar ltar 'bul zhing*/ rgyal ba kun gyi sogs kyis bstod/ rigs so so'i thugs kar sngags phreng bkod la bzlas pa ci nus kyi mthar/

gtor ma/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ a kā ro lan gsum gyis brlab/ mdun bskyed kyi lha mo rigs gsum gyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol bar bsams la/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa shā ba rī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gsum gyis dbul/ mchod bstod sngar bzhin dang*/ ri khrod lha mo 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pas bdag gi rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams 'jug cing byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes slob ma'i don du gsol ba lan gsum btab pas rjes su gnang bar bsam/ gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ slob ma rnams gral la 'khod par las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu dang*/ slob dpon gyis las bum thogs te/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ a mṛ ta bzlas pas khrus bya/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spros te khyed rang rnams la rjes su gnang ba zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs dang log par 'dren pa thams cad rgyangs ring du bskrad pa'i thugs mos mdzod/ na mo/ rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka'= chos kyi= dge 'dun= de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ las kyi rigs su rab tu bzhugs pa rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ snying po dang*/ sngags dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang rig sngags kyi bdag po khro bo dang*/ khro mo rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ khyad par du yang dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi ye shes sgyu ma'i rnam rol bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lha mo rigs gsum gyi bden pa dang*/

bden pa chen po de dag gi mthu la brten nas/ deng 'dir rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la rjes su gnang ba zab mo sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad sa yi phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig gang dag mi 'gro zhing 'dug pa de dag thams cad khro bo'i ye shes kyi rdo rje me rab tu 'bar ba 'dis mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par 'gyur ta re/ zhes dang*/ a mṛ ta'i sngags dang*/ sum+bha ni sogs brjod la yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ ces brda sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug 'o ma gyur nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du zhes sogs kun slong gsal gdab pa ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i chos ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma'i skor yin/ de la'ang bka' srol mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod pa las/ da lam 'dir skabs su bab pa ni/ 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs 'dzin pa thams cad kyi nang nas nyi ma dang zla ba ltar yongs su grags pa dpal ldan srad rgyud pa'i lugs kyi ri khrod lha mo rigs gsum gyi rjes gnang zab mo 'bul ba'i skabs su bab pa yin cing*/ de la'ang lo rgyus cung zad cig snyan du gsol ba'i dbang du byas na/ rgya gar gyi grub chen zhig gis 'bri 'tshams kyi sngags pa zhig la gnang*/ des rang gi rigs brgyud kho na las gzhan du mi ster ba'i bka' rgya btab nas rim par brgyud pa las/ phyis paṇa chen bsam 'grub rgya mtshos de'i sngags pa zhig la nga la ster dgos gsungs pas/ khyed nges cag gi skyabs mgon yin pas phul dgos mod kyang*/ gzhan la mi spel ba'i dam bca' bzhes dgos zhus pas/ kho bos 'gro ba la phan e thogs bsam pa yin gyi/ gzhan spel mi rung na mi dgos gsungs nas ma bzhes/

slad nas rgyud chen sangs rgyas rgya mtsho de'i rigs rgyud du 'khrungs pas/ dus phyis rang gi khu bo sngags btsun zhig la ster dgos gsungs pas/ khyod la ster kyang gzhan la ma spel gsungs/ de la de ring khyod kyis stsol ba'i nyin 'dir skyor ba dang 'bri ba byed dgos gzhan mi byed ces gsungs nas/ rgyud chen dkon mchog rgya mtsho la yol ba'i phag tu gsan bcug nas gnang*/ des rgyud chen dkon mchog yar 'phel sogs shin tu mang po la sgrub thabs rjes gnang las tshogs dang bcas pa gnang ste dar rgyas su mdzad pa nas/ bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa'i rjes gnang zab mo 'bul ba la/ sngon 'gro slob dpon gyi bya ba rnams legs par grub zin nas/ dngos gzhi slob ma'i ngo skal du gyur pa la/ thog mar gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs lan gsum/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bla ma dang tha mi dad pa'i bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lha mo rigs gsum la skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgya mtshos bskor ba mngon sum lta bur bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba can gyi byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs nas/ sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*// bar lan gsum/ de nas rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa yin pas thugs dmigs 'di bzhin du mdzod/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ slob ma rnams kyi phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las slob ma rnams gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs rin po che sna tshogs kyi ri bo dang*/ zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig rnams dor/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/

rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi sku che chung dpag tu med pa gnam sa bar snang gi khyon thams cad khengs pa tsam du spyan drangs te/ slob ma rnams kyi lus la thim pas dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags gsum po'i mthar/ ā be sha ya a āḥ zhes btags pa mang du brjod/ de nas slob dpon de nyid kyang tha mal gyi slob dpon 'di lta bu ma yin par bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma sku mdog gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba zhes sogs nas sbrul dkar pos se ral khar byas pas mtshan pa dang*/ mdun gyi gtor ma 'di nyid kyang bsgrubs zin pa ltar bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma gyon ma sogs nas/ se ral kha byas pas mtshan par gsal btab nas/ rjes su gnang ba dngos la gsum yod pa las/ thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsum ye shes dbyer med pa// 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog rje btsun ma'i// sku yi rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gtor ma lhar bskyed pa la phog de'i ri khrod ma rigs gsum gyi gnas lnga las ri khrod ma dkar dmar mthing ser ljang gu lnga tshan gsum spros/ slob ma'i rigs gsum gyi gnas lnga so so la thim/ lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag rdo rje'i sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag khyad par lus kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib sngar yod dag cing phyin chad mi 'jug pa'i phyir/ ri khrod ma'i sku dkar po'i rwa ba/ 'khor lo'i rwa ba/ 'od dkar po'i rwa ba gsum gyis bskor bas sra brtan gzhom gzhig dang bral ba'i thugs mos mdzod/ gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs nas/ gsung gi rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul/

de rnams kyi thugs ka nas rang rang so so'i sngags kyi phreng bar mar me gcig las gnyis mched kyi tshul du byon/ slob ma lha mo rigs gsum du gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la rang rang gi sku mdog dang mthun pa'i pam̐ yig gis mtshan pa'i mthar 'khod par mos la sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos lan gsum re mdzod/ sngags gsum gyi rjes zlos bya/ des ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag rdo rje'i gsung 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag khyad par du ngag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib slar mi 'jug pa'i phyir sngar bsgoms pa'i sku'i rwa ba gsum gyi nang du/ ri khrod ma dmar mo'i rwa ba/ de'i nang du pad+ma'i rwa ba/ de'i nang du 'od dmar po'i rwa ba gsum gyis bskor ba'i thugs mos mdzod/ gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs nas/ thugs kyi rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed kyi rigs gsum gyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la/ rnam pa rigs so so'i phyag mtshan rdo rje ser po dang nag po rtse lnga pa/ pad+ma dmar po rtse gsum pa dpag tu med pa byung*/ slob ma'i snying gar sib sib thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib dag thugs rdo rje 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag khyad par yid kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib slar mi 'jug pa'i phyir rwa ba snga ma rnams kyi nang du ri khrod ma nag mo'i rwa ba/ de'i nang du rdo rje'i rwa ba/ de'i nang du 'od sngon po'i rwa ba gsum gyis bskor ba'i thugs mos mdzod/ de nas mtha' rten gtor ma la brten nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ gtor ma 'di nyid ri khrod lha mo rigs gsum du gsal ba slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor drangs nas bka' bsgos pa ltar zhal gyis bzhes nas byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bar chad thams cad sel ba dang*/

dngos grub thams cad stsol ba'i thugs mos mdzod/ gtor ma mgo bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// lhag pa'i lhar ni mdzad du gsol// dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol// dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gtor ma lhar gsal ba las rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad nas khyed rang rnams la gnyis su med par thim pas ye shes sems dpa'i tshul gyis byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'bral med du bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de nas/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas// snying po 'dus pa'i bcud 'di ni// de ring bu yis bza' bar bya// 'di zos ri khrod lha mo yi// zhal zas bsten na nad kun las// grol 'gyur the tshom bya mi dgos// zhes brjod la gtor ma'i mtha' nas ril bu rnams sbyin/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi legs par grub nas/ de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la tshul bzhin du bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig phul mdzod/ de tsam du ma zad lus longs spyod thams cad kyang phul na cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ de rnams kyis dpal ldan srad rgyud pa'i lugs kyi ri khrod lha mo rigs gsum gyi rjes gnang zab mo brgyud ldan dam pa'i phyag len las byung ba ltar lhag chad med par legs par phul grub pa yin pas 'di'i sgo nas kyang rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ gsum pa rjes ni/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa kha gsos la bsang sbyang byin rlabs mchod bstod sogs sngar ltar la/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/

ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bshags/ gtor ma'i ye shes pa badz+ra muḥs/ rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsam/ rang yang rim gyis 'od du zhu nas mi dmigs par gyur par bsams la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de'i ngang las skad cig gis ri khrod ma'i skur lam gyis gsal gdab/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs bsngo smon dang*/ ston mchog dam pa sogs shis pa brjod pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// yang sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar sngar ltar dang*/ bzlas pa'i mjug tu gtor mgron spyan drangs la gtor ma 'bul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol gdab/ gtor mgron rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs su gsol/ bsngo smon shis brjod sogs spyi dang mthun par bya/ de lta bu'i rim pas sngags gsum po grangs rab bye ba'am mtshan ma mthong ba'i bar dang*/ 'bring 'bum phrag cha shas/ ma mtha' yang 'bum phrag gcig gam khri phrag brgyad bzla ba ni las rung gi bsnyen pa'i tshad yin la/ las kha tshar gyi sngags gnyis po ni thun gyi mjug tu ji ltar rigs pa tsam bzla ba las grangs tshad kyi nges pa med do// smras pa/ ri khrod lha mo rigs gsum gyi// sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i// bdud rtsi'i sprin mdzes 'di shar bas// nad gdon tsha gdung yongs su bcil// de las byung ba'i dge tshogs ni// ga bur gsar pa'i thigs phreng gis// 'gro kun phan bde'i ngal 'tsho la// nyams med longs su spyod gyur cig /ces pa'ang rje bla ma mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug bcu phrag rig pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta dkon mchog bstan pa rab rgyas kyi zhal snga nas bkra shis lhun po dpal gyi sde chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling chen por ji ltar stsal ba'i phyag len dang*/ rje thu'u bkwan pa blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma'i yig cha sogs la brten nas bklags chog ma'i tshul du shar mdo khams kyi btsun pa bskal bzang mkhyen brtse'i ming can gyis sbyar ba shre yo bha ba tu//
